# List of most-liked Instagram posts [![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/c/c8/Lionel_Messi_WC2022.jpg/500px-Lionel_Messi_WC2022.jpg)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Lionel_Messi_WC2022.jpg) [Lionel Messi](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lionel_Messi), the current record-holder, at the [2022 FIFA World Cup](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2022_FIFA_World_Cup). The most-liked post as of July2026[[update]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=List_of_most-liked_Instagram_posts&action=edit) is of the Argentine [footballer](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Football_player) [Lionel Messi](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lionel_Messi) and his teammates celebrating the [2022 FIFA World Cup](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2022_FIFA_World_Cup) win at [Lusail Stadium](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lusail_Stadium) in [Lusail](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lusail), [Qatar](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Qatar), which has been liked by over 74 million different accounts. Uploaded on December 18, 2022, the post shows Messi lifting his first World Cup Trophy after [Argentina](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Argentina_national_football_team)'s win over [France](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/France_national_football_team) in the [final](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2022_FIFA_World_Cup_final). ## History On January 4, 2019, the account [@world_record_egg](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Instagram_egg) posted a photo of an egg with the specific purpose of surpassing the then most-liked Instagram post, a picture of [Kylie Jenner](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kylie_Jenner)'s daughter with 18.6 million likes. [[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_most-liked_Instagram_posts#cite_note-INSIDER-4) The creator of the @world_record_egg account was Chris Godfrey, an advertising creative, and his friends CJ Brown and Alissa Khan-Whelan. [[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_most-liked_Instagram_posts#cite_note-8) Platanov was surprised by his photo's popularity, writing, "Egg is just an egg." On December 18, 2022, [footballer](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Football_player) [Lionel Messi](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lionel_Messi) posted a [carousel](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Instagram#Features_and_tools) with photos of him lifting the [FIFA World Cup Trophy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/FIFA_World_Cup_Trophy) and celebrating with his teammates after winning the [2022 FIFA World Cup](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2022_FIFA_World_Cup) with [Argentina](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Argentina_national_football_team), which reached 10 million likes within the first 39 minutes of its sharing. [[10]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_most-liked_Instagram_posts#cite_note-10)[[11]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_most-liked_Instagram_posts#cite_note-11) On December 20, 2022, the post reached over 56 million likes, surpassing the previous record held by [@world_record_egg](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Instagram_egg). Within 48 hours of Messi posting, the [Instagram](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Instagram) post had surpassed 64 million likes, and in doing so, it became the most-liked social media post ever across all social media platforms, by overtaking the most-liked post on [YouTube](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/YouTube), the music video for the song " [Despacito](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Despacito)", which had reached 50.2 million likes, and the most-liked post on [TikTok](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/TikTok), a video uploaded by [Bella Poarch](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bella_Poarch) featuring her lip-syncing to the song "Sophie Aspin Send", which had reached 60.3 million likes. ## Historical most-liked posts | Account name | Owner | Post description | Post | Likes

**Likes**: 74M+

**Posted by**: @ [leomessi](https://www.instagram.com/p/CmUv48DLvxd/)

Lionel Messi, arguably the greatest footballer of all time, holding the World Cup trophy, at last.

Prior to this, Messi had _everything_: Ballon d’Ors, Champions League titles, Olympic gold.

## 2. The World Record Egg (2019)
At the time, the most-liked photo on Instagram was Kylie Jenner’s birth announcement (18M+ likes).

## 14. Cristiano Ronaldo and Georgina Rodríguez announce they're expecting twins (2021)
![Cristiano Ronaldo and Georgina Rodríguez announce they're expecting twins](https://www.cms.influize.com/sites/default/files/2025-05/cristiano-ronaldo-and-georgina-rodriguez-announce-theyre-expecting-twins.jpg)

**Likes**: 32M

Kylie Jenner’s 2018 birth reveal was the most-liked photo on the platform before the World Record Egg took that spot. Her [2022 photo of her newborn son and daughter](https://www.instagram.com/p/CZp7xP-P7lM/) reached over 22 million likes. And Justin Bieber’s [first photo of his son](https://www.instagram.com/p/C_CV7GLJBA3/) quickly became one of the top 10 most-liked Instagram posts, excluding the football world.

## Comparative and trend analysis
### Football (soccer) dominates Instagram.
Over half of the top 20 posts are from just two players: Lionel Messi and Cristiano Ronaldo. That’s not a coincidence. Their reach spans continents, languages, and demographics.

For brands, aligning with the sport (even through adjacent content like commentary or reaction videos) gives you massive virality potential.

### Celebrity intimacy > celebrity glamour.
A father-son photo.

#### By Sanjesh Singh •Published August 26, 2025•Updated on August 27, 2025 at 1:28 pm
![](https://media.nbclosangeles.com/2024/02/travis-kelce-taylor-swift.jpg?quality=85&strip=all&resize=1200%2C675)

NBC Universal, Inc.

Who knew English and gym teachers could be so popular?

[Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce](https://www.nbclosangeles.com/entertainment-news/donna-kelce-seemingly-hinted-travis-kelce-taylor-swift-engagement/) took over the internet with their [social media post about getting engaged](https://www.nbclosangeles.com/entertainment-news/taylor-swift-travis-kelce-engaged/), garnering over 30 million likes and counting on Instagram -- and it'll keep increasing.

It's news that was always expected to generate plenty of buzz ever since the [NFL](https://www.nbclosangeles.com/tag/nfl/) star and pop star went public with their [romance in the summer of 2023](https://www.nbclosangeles.com/entertainment-news/travis-kelce-proposed-to-taylor-swift-two-weeks-ago/).

But now that it's official, the traction of their post raises the question: What is the most liked Instagram post?

The top 20 is not dominated by any musician or NFL athlete, though. In fact, two of sports' marquee personas appear in more than half of the top 20 and exactly half in the top 10.

Those personas are [Lionel Messi](https://www.nbcmiami.com/tag/inter-miami/) and [Cristiano Ronaldo](https://www.nbclosangeles.com/video/news/sports/5-things-to-know-about-cristiano-ronaldo/). While Swift's 280-million-plus Instagram followers are nothing to scoff at, Ronaldo boasts 663 million with Messi at 506 million. But Ronaldo actually does not have the most liked post on the platform.

![](https://media.nbclosangeles.com/2023/10/new-thumn.00_01_09_04.Still002.png)

NBC New York

Here are five things to know about Lionel “Leo” Messi, one of the greatest footballers of all time, who plays for Argentina’s national team and MLS club Inter Miami.

So, who is on top? Here's a list of the top 10 most liked posts on Instagram following Swift and Kelce's engagement:

## 10. XXXTentacion
After rapper XXXTentacion was fatally shot in May 2018, his last -- and only -- Instagram [post](https://www.instagram.com/p/Bi-hISIghYe/) is over 34 million likes.

See more

## 9. Cristiano Ronaldo
On Dec. 24, 2024, Ronaldo posted a [reel](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DD-KT-OAL_U) where he was shirtless during a snowy day in Finland that drew over 35.7 million likes.

## 8. Emil Reinert
On Sept. 8, 2024, a [reel](https://www.instagram.com/reel/C_qU9qyo9_M/) posted by Emil Reinert of a young girl singing along to Celene Dion's "My Heart Will Go On" reached 37.1 million likes.

## 7. Lionel Messi
Messi's [2022 World Cup win](https://www.nbclosangeles.com/news/sports/world-cup-2022/argentina-celebrates-world-cup-title-with-millions-of-supporters-in-buenos-aires/) is a key factor in many of the top-liked posts. This one of him with the trophy on an airplane posted on Dec. 19, 2022, reached 41.2 million.

See more

## 5. Insta360
Moving to a more recent post from April 22, 2025, a POV [reel](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DJf0_RmSd-T/) of a young girl garnered 44.5 million likes thanks to extreme wholesomeness.

## 3. Lionel Messi
Back to Messi, his post on Dec. 20, 2022 went viral for sleeping with the World Cup trophy. The post is at 53.7 million likes.

See more

## 2. Chris Godfrey
Egg. On January 4, 2019, Godfrey attempted to set a world record for the most-liked Instagram post, which at the time was 18 million by Kylie Jenner. The plain egg is at 60.5 million and counting after all these years.

See more

## 1. Lionel Messi
Finishing off with Messi, his post on Dec. 18, 2022 -- his first after Argentina won the World Cup over France -- is at 74.5 million likes.

See more

Swift and Kelce's post is inching closer to cracking the top 10 and could eventually break in.

However, when removing soccer players' posts such as Messi and Ronaldo, then the Swift-Kelce post would easily be near the top.

Fellow pop star Selena Gomez occupies three of the top 20 most-liked Instagram posts that doesn't include a soccer player.
